explanation: I found no match in Mathlib. The proof only uses lemmas from the library itself: `Monic.irreducible_of_degree_le_five_of_not_isRoot_of_not_quadratic_dvd` and `X_sq_add_C_mul_X_add_C_dvd_X_pow_five_add_iff`. Neither one is in Mathlib. I searched Mathlib for `X_pow_five`, `degree_le_five` and `X ^ 5`. The only hit was an unrelated division-polynomial formula in the elliptic-curve files. I also searched for theorem names of the form `irreducible_of_degree_le…` and `irreducible…X_pow…C_mul_X` and found nothing. As far as I can tell, Mathlib has no irreducibility criterion for quintics of the form X^5 + cX + d, and no general "no roots and no quadratic factor" test for degree-5 polynomials.
